subject: Statue of Liberty
hook: STATUE OF LIBERTY IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Though famous as a welcoming beacon for arriving immigrants, the Statue of Liberty was originally conceived by French abolitionists to celebrate the Union victory in the Civil War and the end of slavery, which is why Lady Liberty is depicted stepping on a broken chain and shackle.
angle_support: With her left foot she steps on a broken chain and shackle, commemorating the national abolition of slavery following the American Civil War.

According to the National Park Service, the idea of a monument presented by the French people to the United States was first proposed by Édouard René de Laboulaye, president of the French Anti-Slavery Society and a prominent and important political thinker of his time.
title: The Statue of Liberty's Secret Meaning
description: While widely recognized as a symbol for immigrants, the statue was actually created by French abolitionists to commemorate the end of slavery and the Union's victory in the Civil War. The broken chains at her feet serve as a direct reference to this liberation.
narration: STATUE OF LIBERTY IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture a welcoming beacon for arriving immigrants. It was closer to a political statement. The statue was originally conceived to honor the Union victory over slavery. Designed by French abolitionist Édouard de Laboulaye, it celebrates the end of the American Civil War. Look at her feet. Lady Liberty is literally stepping on a broken chain and shackle, marking the national abolition of slavery. She was built to symbolize freedom, not just an immigration port.
